name: tpl-chain-response-3-nogoal
task: If the box falls, the very next move must pick it up again. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clauses accurately capture the task goals and rules. Existence(at_exit) hard enforces reaching the exit as the goal. Response(at_exit, holding_box) hard enforces carrying the box upon reaching the exit (effectively checking at the same step since it's the last). ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) hard correctly implements 'very next move must pick it up again' for the fall condition. Propositions are grounded and priorities match the task wording.

texts: If at exit, must hold box
After box falls, pick up next step
